title: Shopping cart helper with a mutable default argument

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,16 @@
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Item:
+    sku: str
+    price_cents: int
+
+
+def add_item(item: Item, cart: list[Item] = []) -> list[Item]:
+    cart.append(item)
+    return cart
+
+
+def total_cents(cart: list[Item]) -> int:
+    return sum(i.price_cents for i in cart)

expected.description: Mutable default list is shared across calls, so carts leak items between users
